The '''Lead Bobber''' is a [[tackle]] that helps [[fishing]] by preventing the bar from bouncing. It can be purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|200}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 6]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|150}}. It is one of two fishing tackle that cannot be [[Crafting|crafted]], along with the [[Curiosity Lure]].

Using two Lead Bobbers on an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] prevents the fishing bar from bouncing even more compared to using one.
